svg.title: ICV–03 / MIYAMOTO
svg.text: Longitudinal section and interior details · bow to the right
01 / OFFSET SECTION A–A · STARBOARD RESCUE BAY OPEN
380 m between tail and bow datum
Section jogs from the starboard drive and fuel line through the rescue bay to the centreline at the collar. The far bay roof is shown in elevation.
03 / AFT DRIVE AND BLAST BULKHEAD · LONGITUDINAL DETAIL
Hatched edges denote the cut shell and bulkheads. Internal fixtures are layout studies. The six triage beds exclude quarantine berths.
